successful_hooks.hook: 男主也重生+等了一辈子

paywall_cards.effectiveness_notes: Ch3 uses physical discomfort + emotional contrast; Ch6 uses information asymmetry bomb; Ch9 uses revenge anticipation; Ch13 uses romantic revelation

lessons_learned: First-person rebirth POV naturally reduces dialogue ratio vs third-person source
Hard forbidden words (嘻嘻/一丝) can slip in during natural writing - must scan early
Scene expansion is more efficient when adding conflict detail rather than description
10000 char minimum requires deliberate planning at beat-bible stage for 14 chapters
